title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
description: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
description: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
description: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
description: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Last day

title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
description: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

title: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
description: Figma is also releasing its code layers feature in open beta.

title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
description: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

title: Gudea leverages AI to help organizations prevent social media crises before they erupt
description: Gudea, a company that tracks how stories and rumors spread online that describes itself as the “storm tracker for the internet,” is using AI to help organizations spot trouble brewing online before it turns into a crisis.

title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect ‘just gunshots’ — its website says different
description: Langley’s comments come amid mounting scrutiny of Flock from privacy advocates, including the ACLU, and members of the public who are concerned about the misuse of its technology.

title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
description: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
description: Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows. Apate.ai sends them undercover to get scammed.
